summary: Comprehensive implementation plan to redesign and fix the AI Vocab Quiz, including a compact single-screen configuration modal with Question Count and Word Pool controls, spoiler-free Instant Practice feedback across Cloze/Reading Comprehension/Mixed formats, two-zone split passage layout, Global Gemini key resolution alignment, and post-quiz revision tools (Retry Missed Words, Star/Bookmark, and Side-by-Side Passage & Answer Review).
